title: Revenue trend
description: Quarterly revenue (NII + fees) for the selected client over the last 8 closed quarters.

custom.cypher:
WITH datetime.truncate('quarter', datetime($asOfDate)) AS thisQuarter
MATCH (r:RevenueMonth)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(:Client {clientId: $clientId})
WHERE r.month >= thisQuarter - duration({months: 24}) AND r.month < thisQuarter
WITH datetime.truncate('quarter', r.month) AS q, sum(r.totalUsd) AS revenueUsd
RETURN toString(q.year) + ' Q' + toString(q.quarter) AS quarter, revenueUsd
ORDER BY q
